scenes.title: 人物手工 · 陶艺制作
scenes.observation: 手指与碗沿结构、旋转泥土刻痕、湿润反光与真实表面纹理的区分。
scenes.prompt: A 15-second continuous, uncut video of an adult potter slowly shaping a small clay bowl on a rotating pottery wheel. A fixed medium close-up shows both hands, the bowl, and the wheel. The fingers make gentle adjustments to the same bowl throughout the shot. Soft daylight reveals wet clay, fine concentric grooves, skin texture, and subtle reflections on the moist surface. The plain workshop background remains softly out of focus. Natural, steady motion with no cuts or sudden camera movements.

scenes.title: 动物运动 · 草地上的马
scenes.observation: 皮毛与鬃毛新增细节、腿部步态、运动轮廓及遮挡边缘的时间稳定性。
scenes.prompt: A 15-second continuous, uncut video of a chestnut horse trotting at a relaxed, steady pace across a grassy meadow. A smooth side-tracking camera keeps the entire horse visible at a consistent distance. Its dark mane and tail move gently with each stride. Soft afternoon light reveals short coat hairs, subtle muscle movement, and individual strands of the mane. Grass and a distant wooden fence pass slowly through the background. Natural motion with no cuts, sudden turns, or changes of speed.

scenes.title: 建筑空间 · 砖石街道
scenes.observation: 砖缝、窗格、栏杆等重复几何结构在连续透视变化下的稳定性。
scenes.prompt: A 15-second continuous, uncut video moving slowly forward through a quiet historic street lined with brick and stone buildings. The camera maintains a level horizon and a steady walking pace. Repeated window frames, brick courses, wrought-iron railings, and paving stones remain visible as perspective changes gradually. Gentle morning light creates consistent shadows and subtle reflections in the windows. There are no pedestrians, moving vehicles, readable signs, or scene changes. Architectural photography with a natural, restrained appearance.

scenes.title: 自然动态 · 林间溪流
scenes.observation: 固定苔藓与石头的稳定性，流动水纹、透明和反射变化与异常闪烁的区别。
scenes.prompt: A 15-second continuous, uncut video of a shallow stream flowing around moss-covered stones in a green forest. A fixed low camera shows clear moving water in the foreground and ferns along the banks. Sunlight filtered through the trees creates soft reflections on the water. Small ripples continually pass around the same stones, while nearby leaves move gently in a light breeze. Fine moss, wet rock surfaces, and transparent water remain visible throughout the shot, with no cuts or camera movement.

scenes.title: 微距材质 · 雕纹银戒
scenes.observation: 固定雕纹和划痕与移动高光的区分，视角变化下金属材质和新增细节的一致性。
scenes.prompt: A 15-second continuous, uncut macro video of a silver ring standing upright on a slowly rotating matte-black display platform. A fixed camera keeps the entire ring visible and sharply focused. The ring has a simple repeating engraved leaf pattern and a smooth inner surface, without lettering or gemstones. Broad, stationary studio lights create soft highlights that move naturally across the metal as it rotates. Fine scratches, shallow engraving, and brushed silver texture remain visible against a plain dark background.
